name: jp.colloid.uitk-font-fix
description: Font utilities for Unity UI Toolkit editor UIs: safe monospace and CJK UI font resolution, inline/inherited application helpers and text hygiene. Built from empirically verified TextCore behavior on 2022.3. Zero dependencies, Editor-first.

samples.description: Commented EditorWindow showing the canonical composition: language-gated ApplyCjkUi on the window root, an ApplyMono code leaf inside it, sanitized dynamic text via SanitizeDisplayText, a FontFixSettings customization snippet and a pointer to the diagnostics window.

Ready-to-adapt EditMode test that runs GlyphAudit.AuditSourceDirectory over your own editor sources, with its own UNITY_INCLUDE_TESTS-gated test asmdef and a SafeGlyphs whitelist extension via extraCodepoints.
